`systemE.solverTime` is 300s **per solver call** — and these files make multiple solver calls (euclid_apply discharge + euclid_finish), so my 300s per-file timeout killed them mid-way even if each individual call succeeds. Let me re-test two representatives with a generous timeout and capture the real outcome:

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source /u/taddmao/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate
rm -f /tmp/p47b.log
for k in 11 8; do
  echo "===== step$k START =====" | tee -a /tmp/p47b.log
  timeout 1000 lake build Book1.Prop47.step$k >> /tmp/p47b.log 2>&1
  echo "===== step$k EXIT=$? =====" | tee -a /tmp/p47b.log
done
echo "== TAIL =="
tail -60 /tmp/p47b.log
<<<END>>>
